verdict.rationale: Mercury's marketing docs explicitly state cardholders 'earn unlimited cashback automatically deposited into your account — no manual redemption or confusing points,' directly matching the story. However, this claim comes only from first-party marketing copy with no independent/hands-on corroboration of actual cashback amounts, eligibility rules, or card tiers. Missing for 10: independent verification of cashback rates/terms, community confirmation of automatic deposit behavior, and detail on which card products qualify.
